title: Debt and Asset
author: Felix Thackeray
blurb: Sable Whitlock, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
